parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of plywood with a rectangular shape.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the internal storage space, connecting all other parts together.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports the entire cabinet structure.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom platform of the cabinet, made of plywood, supporting the weight of the structure.
parts.Functional_description: It stabilizes the cabinet and distributes the load evenly to the floor or supporting legs.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: The left cabinet door is a flat MDF panel attached to the frame with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior storage space by swinging open and closed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its hinge axis to open or close the cabinet.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: The right cabinet door is a flat MDF panel similar to the left door, attached with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the right side of the cabinet’s interior and closes to protect stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its hinge axis to open or close the cabinet.
